features.name: HEIC fallback when no decoder
features.description: Fallback for devices whose ImageDecoder has no HEIC codec (SM8635 recorded in F017): skip-with-reason vs transcode so HEIC files are not silently missed.

tests.notes: 4 new JVM tests green (259 total via make test); HeicFallbackTest 1/1 PASS on SM8635 (Realme GT 6); SearchUiTest 3/3 PASS same run; make style green

features.notes: Probe corrected F017: MediaCodecList still-mime query is null (encoder only) BUT ImageDecoder decodes sample.heic to 1280x854 via the software HEVC decoder (c2.android.hevc.decoder) — so HeicSupport probes still-mime OR video/hevc (present=true here, no skips on this phone). Engine plan() gained heicDecoderPresent (default true, so other phones never newly skip); false + HEIC -> skipped:no-heic-decoder. F020-1 manual mic checklist still planned for the human.
